headline:
Real pullback,
but historically cheap for the growth
chart_note: 10-day range: $335.02 - $348.06, down 2.8% over the window and 10.3% over the past month - now trading right at the 200-day average ($334.57).
why_today: Down 1.3% today, extending a month-long slide - now roughly 18% below the 52-week high, right at the 200-day moving average.
pro_1: Quarterly earnings up 294% YoY on 24.2% revenue growth - an exceptional beat
pro_2: PE of just 17x and PEG of 0.92 are unusually cheap for this earnings growth rate - analyst sentiment strongly positive (58 of 64 Buy/Strong Buy)
con_1: Down 10.3% in the past month, now below the 50-day average ($349.78) - real short-term weakness, not just noise
con_2: RSI at 40 is approaching oversold territory - worth watching whether the slide continues or stabilizes
